# FDG8010

> DO NOT provide constructor parameters to initialize properties corresponding to the optional arguments.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 8.2 Attributes.

## How it is checked

- Check: sdk (partial coverage)
- Diagnostics: CA1019
- Automatic fix: not applied automatically (the fix can break callers)
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

CA1019 reports a property with a public setter whose name matches a constructor parameter of the attribute (ignoring case), the case "set with both a constructor and a setter" of the body. A constructor parameter that sets an optional property of another name is not seen, so coverage is partial. Removing the setter or the parameter changes the public API, so the fix is breaking.

## From the book

In other words, do not have properties that can be set with both a constructor and a setter. This guideline makes very explicit which arguments are optional and which are required, and it avoids having two ways of doing the same thing.
